items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine and Mrs. "Papa Jack" Laine Interview, 1960-05-23

ctx.x: In 1917. That's one big liar. Because he wasn't even playing music that I remember at that time. That's about when Mr. Wayne Quidditch. And I know when, because my grandson was born in 1917. And he's still living. Lance was born in 1917. Lance.
And that's when he claimed he went to... He went up north with the band. Yeah.
